support_claim: Registry row 4721193 lists MERIDIAN ENERGY PARTNERS LLC and billing records use Meridian Energy Partners LLC, but no observation links the billing referent to that registry identifier.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity evidence, and name similarity alone is insufficient; the packet provides no cross-source identifier tying billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC to registry:4721193, and no evidence establishes distinctness, so UNRESOLVED is the licensed disposition.
